name: feishu-agent-loop
description: Supervise long-running autonomous agent tasks from Feishu (Lark): the agent pushes markdown progress via a bot, and user replies wake it instantly through Feishu's long-connection WebSocket event stream (no polling). Provides the send/receive/self-pacing recipe, delivery verification rules, and hard-won pitfall list for lark-cli based loops. 飞书遥控长任务 Agent:bot 推进度 + 回复秒级唤醒 + 自定步长,含送达校验与血泪坑清单。
